Jill — thanks again for the productive call this morning. As promised, here's a concise kickoff note to align the embedding + rerank workstream and surface the choices that will affect backfill cost and QA cadence. High level: we want a low-risk bootstrap that preserves relevance while keeping compute cost predictable during your Q4 spike.

Attachments: seed_index_sample.json; vectorstore_cost_estimates_q3.pdf; rerank_eval_prompts.xlsx

Summary / asks:
- Scope: backfill ~12M content items (product pages + user-generated reviews) into an FAISS-compatible vectorstore and run a 2-stage retrieval+rerank pipeline for site search.
- Primary constraints from Acme: <8ms p50 for head queries, not to exceed $X/day during peak (see attached estimates).
- Choices to decide by EOD Fri: embedding model size (mid vs small quantized), index format (flat vs IVF-PQ), and initial rerank candidate count (k).

Proposed short plan (next 7 days):
1) Quick index sanity (Grace + Tessa): sample backfill of 50k docs to validate vectorstore plumbing and latency.
2) Cost tradeoff matrix (Karthik): run small experiments for flat vs IVF-PQ with mid & small embedder (report due Wed).
3) Rerank eval (Monica + Ben): run the contained prompt set in rerank_eval_prompts.xlsx over the sample to measure nDCG / precision@k and human review on a 100-case set.

Ask: can you confirm the final cut of content types to include in the bootstrap (product pages + reviews OK?), and whether we should exclude legacy archived pages (older than 2019) from the backfill? Also please share the ops contact who will own the temporary S3 bucket for the seed exports.

I'll book a 30m slot for Thu 10:00am PT for the short smoke test unless you'd prefer a different time.

Best,
Ben

Quick technical notes on index choices and tradeoffs — short version first, details after.

Short recommendation (for the bootstrapped run):
- Embedding model: "mid-quantized" (balanced quality/cost). Small quantized is tempting but historically underperforms on product-description nuance.
- Index format: IVF-PQ with a moderate nlist (e.g., 4096) to get storage savings while keeping probe low; flat index for hot slices only.
- Rerank k: agree to start at k=30 per Jill; we'll monitor recall and bump if we see coverage loss in the QA set.

Risks and mitigations:
- Backfill throughput: 12M at target parallelism will take ~36 hours with our staging cluster; to avoid ops disruption, we recommend a staged backfill (baseline: 2M/day incremental waves).
- Cold start quality: use a small prefix cache seeded with high-traffic product vectors to stabilize early latency. Grace/Tessa can assemble that from the seed export.
- Cost: IVF-PQ reduces storage + search compute but increases complexity for quantized models. I'll produce the mini-bench results by Wed EOD (will run both FAISS-IVF-PQ and HNSW baselines against the sample).

Logistics: Tom, please share S3 path and whether lifecycle rules will apply (we need a temporary 30-day retention). Also confirm if you want us to push directly into your managed vectorstore or into a staging bucket we control and handshake via River (our ingestion pipeline).

-Karthik
